speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms; to begin my assessment, can you describe exactly where on your palms the rash is located and what its texture looks like?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Not yet ready; the patient's history of a year-long itchy rash on the upper body and face, combined with numbness and tingling in the palms, along with exposure to rice farming and livestock, is highly suggestive of scabies (specifically nodular or crusted forms) or a related parasitic infestation like cutaneous leishmaniasis or strongyloides, but I need to confirm if the rash is burrow-like and whether you have seen other family members or livestock with similar symptoms before finalizing. Can you tell me if you have seen other people in your household with similar symptoms?
